items.title: Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)
items.summary: After the floods on the 26th, 734 bodies have been recovered and 2498 people are still missing. More than 8000 have been rescued so far, including over 260 foreigners, while over 400 foreign nationals remain unaccounted for.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Foreign Secretary on Bhote Koshi Flood (Saturday, 2:00 PM, 30 August 2026)

items.title: Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood
items.summary: Search teams have recovered 626 bodies from the Bhote Koshi floods and rescued over 4450 people, though about 2400 remain unaccounted for. Work is still underway in the affected districts with help from teams sent by India and expected from China.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Press Briefing Note by Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs on Bhote Koshi Flood

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods hit Nepal's Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, destroying homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure while leaving many people missing. Rescue teams have recovered 538 bodies so far, with 511 of the 632 people from 33 countries still unaccounted for.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 28 August 2026

items.title: FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang
items.summary: Rescue teams and helicopters are working at the mudslide site in Gyirong Port after it hit Wednesday morning. Three people have been killed and 558 remain missing.
items.citation: Xinhua (Gyirong / Tibet side) — FOCUS | Rescue operations at mudslide-hit border port in SW China's Xizang

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods struck Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River on 26 August, damaging homes, roads and bridges and leaving many people missing. So far 359 bodies have been recovered and 596 people from 33 countries remain unaccounted for.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods-27 August 2026

items.title: NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood
items.summary: Nepal has opened an emergency room to help with search and rescue for foreign nationals caught in the Rasuwa floods. Families can reach them on +977-9744441227 or +977-9744441228 between 7am and 10pm.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — NOTICE: Emergency Control Room (ECR) for Assistance regarding Foreign Nationals Affected by the Bhote Koshi Flash Flood

items.title: Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation
items.summary: India's foreign ministry has set up a 24-hour control room in Delhi for the Nepal floods. Reach them at +91 11 2308 8718 or via WhatsApp at +91 9968291988.
items.citation: MEA press release — Special Control Room in MEA for Nepal Floods Situation

items.title: Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026
items.summary: Flash floods struck Nepal’s Bhote Koshi River this morning, damaging homes, roads, bridges and other infrastructure. So far 72 bodies have been recovered and 403 people from 25 countries are reported missing.
items.citation: Nepal Ministry of Foreign Affairs — Latest Updates on Flash Floods- 26 August 2026

items.summary: The Indian embassy in Kathmandu is working with local authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals hit by the floods in the Rasuwa and Bhotekoshi areas. Families can contact the control room in Delhi or the embassy WhatsApp for help.
